# AllTheMasks DataPack

This datapack is made for the **AllTheMasks** resource pack and is required to use the resource pack in vanilla. 

Download the Resource Pack here: [AllTheMasks ResourcePack Download](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/allthemasks)
## What does it do?

* 🔄 Enables switching masks between **in front of your face** and **on top of your head** using **Sneak + Sprint**.
* 🎭 Adds support for obtaining masks by renaming helmets in an anvil.
* 🌍 Works entirely in vanilla Minecraft.
* 👥 Multiplayer compatible.

## Resource Pack

This datapack requires the matching AllTheMasks Resource Pack, which contains all mask models and textures.

Download the Resource Pack here: [AllTheMasks ResourcePack Download](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/allthemasks)

## Installation

1. Download the matching **AllTheMasks Resource Pack**.
2. Place this datapack in your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload` or reload the world.

## Getting Masks

Masks are obtained by **renaming any helmet** in an anvil. Rename it to the name of any supported mask.
A complete **list of all available masks** can be found on the [website](https://bettervanillabuilding.com/allthemasks/).

![Website](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/883a558d9c60f756a2ef27b9d212a433cb5b2570.png)
